PARTIAL rather than PASS for exactly one reason: prettier --check exits 1 on the changed component. No production or staging system was contacted. DATABASE_URL, REDIS_URL and S3_ENDPOINT were confirmed to resolve to 127.0.0.1 by hostname only; no secret value was read, printed or referenced.

Unexpected finding: the live region updates on every keystroke and appends a full sentence at zero matches, which is louder than the previous behaviour that never announced the message at all. Raised for the reviewer rather than accepted silently. FR-005 forbids introducing a debounce, so it cannot be resolved inside this specification.
No real screen reader was exercised and none is claimed. The evidence is the browser accessibility tree as Playwright reads it.

Residual: E2E-006 depends on /platform/audit holding at least eight rows, because WorkspaceTable renders no search box below that threshold. It passed here; the precondition is not guaranteed by the suite itself.
